commits.subject: feat(api): add staff integration registry portal
commits.description: Staff will be able to use a separately hosted Arbiter portal to register and manage shared API integrations under current staff and executive permissions. The portal shows safe registry details and credential counts while Arbiter's API keeps sessions, authorization, credential invalidation, and storage private; it also includes exact-origin browser protections and typed failure guidance. This ships the deployable portal artifact and management API, but does not deploy a production site or change Discord commands or current member workflows.
